changelogHeadings: A guided tour of every update.
The real panel, in both guides.

steps.title: Start here: Print / Panel Guide
steps.body: The highlighted printer button in the app toolbar opens your panel reference. You can also use Help → Panel Reference · View / Print / Save…. The real guide is shown below so you can practice its controls here. This walkthrough changes no assignments or Lightroom settings.

steps.title: A larger glass guide, while you hold
steps.body: Press Previous Still + Next Still together within 300 ms and keep both held. The guide now fills more of your screen with larger assignment labels and a glass background. Release either key to dismiss it without taking keyboard focus from Lightroom. Use Zoom for close-ups and click an assignment for its full text. Reduce Transparency or Increase Contrast uses an opaque treatment. Printed guides and PDFs keep their clean paper styling. Single-key mappings still work; no hardware press is required to continue this tour.

steps.title: Choose the map, mode or bank
steps.body: Use the highlighted Map menu to choose Live, Base, a named mode and bank, a custom program or a combination. Live reflects your active controls. All modes compares the diagrams. Try the menu here: this only changes the reference view, not the panel's assignments.

steps.title: See turns, taps, presses and holds
steps.body: Turn / Tap shows knobs and wheels turning and button taps. Press / Hold shows knob presses and button holds; Both views shows both diagrams. Click any assignment for its complete text below the drawing. The same 58 physical controls stay in position in every view.

steps.title: Make small button labels easy to read
steps.body: The highlighted Zoom menu enlarges Knobs, Left keys, Centre keys, Right keys or Wheels. Try a region, then choose Whole panel to return. This is especially useful for detailed assignments on the side keys.

steps.title: Print the view, the complete guide or close-ups
steps.body: Open full guide in browser, then use these highlighted print buttons. Print this view / PDF prints your selected mode, gesture and zoom. Print complete guide / PDF includes all modes and both gestures. Print enlarged sections makes five close-up pages per gesture. Choose Save as PDF in the browser print dialog; use printer scaling for your paper.

steps.title: Save a panel image for your phone or tablet
steps.body: In the full browser guide, Save selected Turn / Tap PNG exports the selected map's turn/tap diagram. Choose Press / Hold to export that gesture instead. Both views still exports the named gesture on the button. For both current diagrams together, use the app's Help → Save Current Panel Image…. Full overflow labels are included.

steps.title: Find this walkthrough again
steps.body: Help → Show This Update's Walkthrough… replays these steps. Take the Hands-On Tour starts with this guide, then continues with panel practice. Quick Reference has the shortcut and export instructions; What’s New in the menu bar or Settings keeps the changelog. Click Done to mark this build's walkthrough complete. Later or closing the app keeps it unfinished.
